scope: NFL event-specific player props, including the documented first-quarter passing-yards market. Alternate-line market duplicates are excluded.
source_section: NFL, NCAAF, CFL Player Props API
coverage_note: Provider-documented NFL markets. A documented market is not guaranteed to be offered for every game, bookmaker, player or account. Preserve the exact bookmaker outcome and threshold.
selection_basis: Provider-documented NFL market coverage; no measured betting-popularity ranking is supplied by this source.
request_note: The 15 default markets cover core passing, rushing, receiving and touchdown research. The 18 optional markets are requested on demand to avoid unnecessary provider usage credits.
first_touchdown_note: The documented NFL player_1st_td market is first touchdown scorer for the game. First touchdown scorer for a team is a distinct market and has no key listed in the provider's NFL section.
statistic_note: A statistic identifies an available descriptive historical metric, not a forecast or settlement rule. Rush + receiving touchdowns exclude passing, return and other touchdowns. A null statistic means matching historical detail is not available from the connected weekly statistics feed.

markets.label: Passing yards
markets.definition: Player passing yards over or under the exact bookmaker line.

markets.label: Passing touchdowns
markets.definition: Touchdown passes thrown by the player, over or under the exact line. A passing touchdown is not a touchdown scored by that passer.

markets.label: Pass attempts
markets.definition: Player pass attempts over or under the exact bookmaker line.

markets.label: Pass completions
markets.definition: Player completed passes over or under the exact bookmaker line.

markets.label: Interceptions thrown
markets.definition: Interceptions thrown by the passer, over or under the exact line; this is distinct from interceptions made by a defender.

markets.label: Rushing yards
markets.definition: Player rushing yards over or under the exact bookmaker line.

markets.label: Carries (rush attempts)
markets.definition: Player rushing attempts, also called carries, over or under the exact bookmaker line.

markets.label: Rushing touchdowns
markets.definition: Touchdowns scored by rushing, over or under the exact bookmaker line; receiving and passing touchdowns are excluded.

markets.label: Receiving yards
markets.definition: Player receiving yards over or under the exact bookmaker line.

markets.label: Receptions
markets.definition: Player completed receptions over or under the exact bookmaker line. Targets are a separate historical workload statistic.

markets.label: Receiving touchdowns
markets.definition: Touchdowns scored by receiving, over or under the exact bookmaker line; rushing and passing touchdowns are excluded.

markets.label: Rush + receiving yards
markets.definition: The sum of player rushing and receiving yards, over or under the exact bookmaker line. Passing yards are excluded.

markets.label: Anytime touchdown scorer
markets.definition: Whether the player scores a touchdown at any point in the game. Touchdown passes thrown do not make the passer a touchdown scorer. Historical totals include sourced rushing, receiving, special-teams, defensive, and fumble-recovery scores. These totals are descriptive, not scoring probabilities; the bookmaker's scoring rules govern settlement.

markets.label: Touchdowns scored (over only)
markets.definition: Player touchdowns scored over the exact returned threshold. Only an Over 1.5 outcome represents 2+ touchdowns; do not relabel another threshold as 2+. Passing touchdowns thrown are distinct.

markets.label: First touchdown scorer
markets.definition: Whether the player scores the first touchdown of the game, not merely the first touchdown for their team. Season touchdown totals do not establish first-touchdown counts or probabilities; matching play-by-play scoring sequence is required.

markets.label: Pass + rushing yards
markets.definition: The sum of player passing and rushing yards, over or under the exact bookmaker line. Receiving yards are excluded.

markets.label: Pass + rush + receiving yards
markets.definition: The sum of player passing, rushing and receiving yards, over or under the exact bookmaker line.

markets.label: Pass + rush + receiving touchdowns
markets.definition: The sum of touchdown passes thrown and rushing and receiving touchdowns scored by the player, over or under the exact line. This explicitly includes passing touchdowns and is distinct from anytime touchdown scorer.

markets.label: Rush + receiving touchdowns
markets.definition: The sum of player rushing and receiving touchdowns, over or under the exact bookmaker line. Passing, return and other touchdowns are excluded.

markets.label: Longest pass completion
markets.definition: Yardage of the player's longest completed pass in the game, over or under the exact line. This is a single-play maximum, not total passing yards.

markets.label: Longest rush
markets.definition: Yardage of the player's longest rush in the game, over or under the exact line. This is a single-play maximum, not total rushing yards.

markets.label: Longest reception
markets.definition: Yardage of the player's longest reception in the game, over or under the exact line. This is a single-play maximum, not total receiving yards.

markets.label: First-quarter passing yards
markets.definition: Player passing yards during the first quarter only, over or under the exact line. Full-game or season passing yards do not provide quarter-specific results.

markets.label: Touchdowns scored (over/under)
markets.definition: Player touchdowns scored over or under the exact returned threshold. This market includes both outcome sides and is distinct from the over-only market. Touchdown passes thrown are separate; bookmaker scoring rules govern settlement.

markets.label: Last touchdown scorer
markets.definition: Whether the player scores the last touchdown of the game. Season touchdown totals do not establish last-touchdown counts or probabilities; matching play-by-play scoring sequence is required.

markets.label: Field goals made
markets.definition: Field goals made by the kicker, over or under the exact bookmaker line. Field-goal attempts and extra points are separate quantities.

markets.label: Kicking points
markets.definition: Points scored by the kicker through field goals and points after touchdowns, over or under the exact bookmaker line.

markets.label: Extra points made
markets.definition: Successful points after touchdowns by the kicker, over or under the exact bookmaker line. This is distinct from field goals and total kicking points.

markets.label: Defensive sacks
markets.definition: Sacks credited to the defensive player, over or under the exact bookmaker line. These are distinct from sacks taken by a quarterback; use the returned line and bookmaker rules for fractional sack credit.

markets.label: Solo tackles
markets.definition: Solo tackles credited to the defensive player, over or under the exact bookmaker line. Assisted tackles are excluded.

markets.label: Assisted tackles
markets.definition: Assisted tackles credited to the defensive player, over or under the exact bookmaker line. In the NFL market this is a defensive statistic, not a basketball assist.

markets.label: Tackles + assists
markets.definition: Combined tackles and assists credited to the defensive player, over or under the exact bookmaker line. Preserve the bookmaker's exact grading rules and threshold.

markets.label: Defensive interceptions
markets.definition: Interceptions made by the defensive player, over or under the exact bookmaker line. These are distinct from interceptions thrown by a passer.
